name: Add gum to bag and change quantity
description: Verifies the primary shopping flow adds a gum pack, exposes it in the bag, and updates quantity and subtotal.
steps: Find Mint Orbit and click Add to bag
In the open bag, increase Mint Orbit quantity from 1 to 2
Confirm the bag shows quantity 2 and the subtotal reflects two packs
expected: Mint Orbit remains in the bag with quantity 2 and the subtotal is ₹158.

name: Filter and search flavors
description: Verifies shoppers can narrow the catalog by flavor and search text, including a useful empty state.
steps: Select the Mint flavor filter and confirm Mint Orbit is visible while Berry Riot is not
Return to All and search for grape
Replace the search with a term that matches no product
expected: Grape Static appears for the grape search, and a no-match message appears for the unmatched search.

name: Validate demo checkout and complete order
description: Verifies checkout rejects invalid contact details, accepts valid demo details, confirms no real payment, and clears the bag.
steps: Add Berry Riot to the bag and open Demo checkout
Submit with an empty name and invalid email, then confirm a validation error is visible
Enter name Alex and email alex@example.com and place the demo order
expected: A demo order confirmation is shown stating no payment was charged, and the bag count resets to zero.

name: Shop from mobile layout
description: Verifies the responsive storefront remains usable on a phone-sized viewport through product selection and cart review.
steps: Add Watermelon Wave to the bag
Confirm the shopping bag opens and displays Watermelon Wave with quantity controls
expected: Watermelon Wave is visible in the mobile bag and can be increased or decreased using the quantity controls.
